name: Sunblight
body:
School evocation [light]; Level arcanist 7, cleric 6, druid 7, inquisitor 5, oracle 6, shaman 7, sorcerer 7, paladin 4, wizard 7, warpriest 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a pinch of vampire’s ashes)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell sheathes the target in natural sunlight (no save). While affected by sunblight, the target is blinded. If the creature is undead, it takes 1d6 points of damage per two caster levels at the start of its turn each round. The target also counts as being in an area of natural sunlight for the duration of the spell. The target must make a Fortitude saving throw at the start of its turn each round. Success means the target is only dazzled instead of blinded for the round, it takes only half damage (if any) from the spell and it is treated as being in an area of bright light instead of natural sunlight for the round.
